title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1170: Myriad race cult’s shot caller (2)

title.p: Chapter 1170: Myriad race cult’s shot caller (2)

section.p: The Sunmoon cultists remained silent. After a short while, a Mountainsea cultist said, “Lord Profound Nine, can Mountainseas become white masks as well? If that’s possible, will Mountainsea white masks receive just as much as the Sunmoon white masks?”

“No.” Su Yu replied, “We have a lot of departments and units in the pavilion. If you’re feeling brave, you can join the Heaven or Earth Department. The Heaven Department is in charge of tracking experts and geniuses. And with connection to these customers, you stand to earn more. If you’re afraid of death like me, you can join the Profound Department and set up a branch somewhere. Even as a Mountainsea, you can still find a suitable place. The Allheaven Battlefield is big enough. There is no lack of places for you to open a branch. This is quite profitable as well.”
“You jest, Lord.”
The Mountainsea smiled fawningly. Who would dare to claim that Profound Nine was scared of death? Was that a joke?
Su Yu said, “We all work hard to cultivate, to the point we’re willing to serve these top powers. Why? For strength. For eternal life.”

Su Yu’s voice turned cold as he continued, “Don’t say some nonsense like working for the benefit of your race. If you’re that kind of person, you wouldn’t have joined the cult. Just follow and work for those willing to pay more. That is the correct path to take. Take you as an example, Sect Master Silverwing. Do you join this sect and become its master because you love becoming a running dog of the six-winged divines? Those people will always look down on their dogs. But in the pavilion, you can control your own fate. If you do well, you will earn well. You will no longer be at the mercy of your masters. Your hard work alone determines everything.”
Silverwing wasn’t offended by those words. He hesitated and said, “But we…”

Su Yu cut him off impatiently, “If you agree to join now, I can temporarily promote all of you into black masks. You will first earn some profit by taking a cut out of what the pavilion makes in the Human Realm. When we’re done here, you can return to the Allheaven Battlefield with us and receive further arrangements depending on your performance here. Of course, some will definitely die during the process. If you die, you naturally won’t receive anything. That’s the same everywhere. Things have probably been quite bad for you guys recently, right? All those myriad race geniuses have entered the Human Realm. And all of them are definitely treating you like slaves. You must have lost a lot of people recently, right?”

The cultists sank into silence again. One of them clenched his teeth and said, “Yes! In the past, we could still enjoy some level of freedom. But a dragon genius has entered the Human Realm recently. The dragon dao protector is also incomparably strong. They found our sect almost immediately and started using us like slaves. We did not even receive much benefits from them, but we did lose a lot of members since their arrival. A vice sect master of mine was killed by that dao protector with a slap for simply being slightly impolite with his words.”
“Damn them!
“Damn them all!”

The other sect masters were also furious. All of them understood that feeling well. In the past, life was still tolerable for them. At the very least, they had their freedom. But now, they were losing even their freedom. The myriad races had decided to put these running dogs they had reared for so many years to use. All sorts of dangerous missions had been assigned to these cultists since the arrival of the myriad races.

The Sunmoon from the Lightning Divine Sect sighed, “The lightning divines are here as well. The dao protector told us to test Mo Duona’s real strength. Our Mountainsea vice sect masters went…and none returned. And now, they were telling me to go personally. For them, we’re worse than cannon fodder.”
This had somehow turned into a support group meeting for them to cry about the myriad races

Su Yu smiled, “Exactly. The various races care too much about race. But the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion is different. Race does not matter to us. I’ll be honest here. I come from the fiery eye race. My race isn’t powerful. Facing the divines, devils, and other major races, I’m nothing. But as Profound Nine, they are nothing. Divines? Devils? Their Sunmoons amount to nothing before me. Fate is something you need to grasp in your own hands. The pavilion is not a charity, but here, you have a better future. Our elders come from various races. Some might even be humans. So what? We don’t care.”
That got the blood of the cultists boiling in anticipation. But they still felt some hesitation.
After thinking about it, Silverwing asked, “What do we need to do to join?”
“First, we need you to kill some people.”
“Hmm?”

Su Yu repeated himself, “Kill some people. Was that so hard to understand? Remove some small fries from the cult. Even if you hadn’t asked for this meeting, I would have started looking for you for the purpose of killing. The pavilion needs to make the situation clearer. First, we will remove all those small fries trying to take advantage of the chaos. All of them will be killed. After all, the pavilion loves solving troubles for everyone.”
The expressions of the cultists changed.

Su Yu continued, “We will kill a lot of people in the Human Realm. I’ll be honest with you guys. Only those capable of surviving will be qualified to follow us when we leave the Human Realm in the future. I don’t see more than half of you surviving. Of course, you can also choose to not join us. Consider me a liar if at the end of this, more than half of you survived.”
Some of them cursed inwardly. He was way too honest. Why was he so honest? Those words were a tad bit too terrifying.
After thinking about it, Silverwing said, “Will we receive any preferential treatment for joining now?”

Su Yu said, “Yes. Each Sunmoon will receive ten drops of sunmoon profound yellow liquid as a joining bonus. Each Mountainsea will receive a drop. You may choose sunmoon profound yellow liquid or other treasures of similar value. The others will not receive any joining bonus. They are free to reject our recruitment. Don’t worry. You will receive more, but that will depend on how well you do after joining.”
“Ten drops?”
The Sunmoons were shocked to hear that.

Su Yu replied, “Yes. That’s our way to calm your nerves. We don’t want you to think that this is merely a lie to get you to work for free. This is a benefit only offered to you. We have never offered such a benefit to any of our white masks in the past.”
Suddenly, White One interrupted, “Profound Nine, this is not a part of our rules.”

Su Yu said, “It’s fine. I will submit an application. There are only three Sunmoons here. They only require thirty drops. Including the seventeen Mountainseas, we won’t even spend fifty drops for this. Yes, this isn’t cheap. But the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion is an organization spanning the Myriad Realms. We need to show a level of generosity befitting our status. If the higher-ups are unwilling to approve my application, I’ll simply pay out of my own pockets.”
Right after hearing that, Silverwing flashed a fawning smile and said,”How can we make you do this, Brother Profound Nine. If the higher-ups refuse to approve this, so be it…”

Su Yu sneered, “So be it? Only a fool will say no when a benefit is offered. Let’s stop wasting time. All the white masks in the Human Realm are currently under my command. You only need to ensure your obedience. We will talk about everything else after concluding our operations here. I’m not offering this out of kindness or to buy your loyalty. I’m paying you to work hard. To kill. Take your payment and work. It’s that simple.”
How straightforward. What a pleasant way of handling things.
A different sect master asked, “Lord, if I join, how about the brothers in my sect?”

Su Yu said, “Do with them as you see fit. If you trust them, you may recruit them as black masks, rainbow masks, and gray masks under you. The pavilion does not mind having more members. After all, we only reward based on work done. After we conclude our operations here, these new members can either remain as our agents or return to the Allheaven Battlefield with us.”
“What if the myriad race experts come looking for us again…”

“We kill.” Su Yu gave a short reply, “It’s simple. Kill them all. The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion does not fear them. So what if we offend them? It’s not like we have never killed their geniuses before. We’re a major power as well. We have eight Invincibles. Unlike the human race, our Invincibles are united. They are also extremely mysterious. When they move together, they won’t even have much of an issue killing lone Invincibles. If they dare to provoke us too much, we’ll simply assassinate their Invincibles. That will teach them to not mess with us.”

The more the cultists listened, the more excited they became. So they could even receive the backing of Invincibles? They could no longer surrender to humanity. That was especially true for Great Xia. No mercy would be shown to any cultist.

As for the myriad races, these cultists were merely running dogs and tools. These cultists would never be viewed as one of them. It really seemed like the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion was their best choice.
The brand new master of the Blood Fire Sect said, “My Blood Fire Sect is backed by the blood fire devils. That is a powerful race filled with lunatics. I worry that…”

Su Yu said, “If I say it’s fine, it will be fine. Just lure their experts over. I’ll kill them for you. If I can’t do it, I can get some help. We will use the blood of the blood fire devils as an offering to the start of our operations here. That race has too many experts. They won’t mind losing a few of them. What’s the name of the genius they sent to the Human Realm? Zhan Ta or something? I’ll kill him for you. If not even this can scare me, why are you so scared?”

They all grimaced upon hearing those words. This Profound Nine was truly a madman. It was as though he knew nothing but killing. That was his sole solution for everything. For him, someone he shouldn’t kill did not seem to exist.
Even White One was grumbling inwardly, wondering if Heavenly Hunt Pavilion had become the leader of the Myriad Realms without him realizing it.
He couldn’t help sending a message to the eighth elder, “Elder, isn’t Profound Nine a tad bit too murderous?”
